name: Tmc2209 → Pwmconf
description: Change the StealthChop PWM settings at runtime. The driver defaults work for most motors. See the `PWMCONF` register and the StealthChop section in the datasheet for tuning. The power-up values are those of a driver as shipped, see the [`tmc2209.chopconf` action](https://esphome.io/components/stepper/tmc2209/#tmc2209-chopconf-action).

config_entries.label: PWM Autograd
config_entries.description: Tune the PWM amplitude gradient automatically. Requires `pwm_autoscale`. The power-up value is `true`.

config_entries.label: PWM Autoscale
config_entries.description: Regulate the PWM amplitude to the motor current automatically. When `false`, `pwm_ofs` and `pwm_grad` set the amplitude directly. The power-up value is `true`.

config_entries.label: PWM Freq
config_entries.description: The PWM frequency, `0` to `3`, for 2/1024, 2/683, 2/512 or 2/410 of the clock frequency (about 23.4, 35.1, 46.9 or 58.5 kHz at 12 MHz). The power-up value is `1`.

config_entries.label: PWM Grad
config_entries.description: The velocity dependent PWM amplitude gradient, `0` to `255`. With `pwm_autograd`, this is the start value for the automatic tuning. The power-up value is `14`.

config_entries.label: PWM Lim
config_entries.description: The limit for the PWM amplitude when switching from SpreadCycle back to StealthChop, `0` to `15`, in units of 16. The power-up value is `12`.

config_entries.label: PWM Ofs
config_entries.description: The PWM amplitude offset, `0` to `255`. With `pwm_autoscale`, this is the start value for the automatic tuning. The power-up value is `36`.

config_entries.label: PWM Reg
config_entries.description: The regulation loop gradient for `pwm_autoscale`, `1` to `15`. This is the maximum change of the PWM amplitude per half wave, from 0.5 for `1` to 7.5 for `15`. A higher value adapts faster to load changes. The power-up value is `8`.
